title: How to Handle Blind Spots in 3 Steps
hook: Stop driving blind in your mirrors.

script.narration: Stop driving blind in your mirrors.
script.visual_search: side mirror car blind spot view

script.narration: First, sit straight and lean your head against the driver side window.
script.visual_search: driver adjusting side mirror in car

script.narration: Second, adjust your left mirror until you can just barely see the side of your car.
Third, lean to the center console and set your right mirror the same way. Like this video if it helped, and follow for daily driving hacks. Have you checked your mirrors today? Comment yes or no.

description: Eliminate dangerous blind spots in just three simple steps. Proper mirror adjustment prevents accidents and keeps you safe on the road. Follow for more essential driving tips.
why_it_will_work: Answers a fundamental beginner search query with a clear, highly visual 3-step solution that viewers want to save and share.
